limitations: Scope is a fail-closed integrity claim on the TESTED paths (fresh/resume/concurrent/unreadable interleavings, each with a deterministic sub-check), NOT an unconditional impossibility proof and NOT Tier-C adversarial ledger integrity. Two accepted LOW test-hygiene items tracked as a follow-up (task_55e10f45): selfcheck fail() leaks a sandbox dir only on a sub-check FAILURE (F-017, pre-existing harness-wide); sub-check M lacks an explicit LOCK_DIR-survival assertion (F-018, confirmed true by inspection).

Write bounded Codex review output to the scratchpad, never tee it into the worktree (untracked file blocks review_run_start). TEST-phase lattice validate runs 34 project commands and the 300s idle-watchdog kills the ~25-min selfcheck under concurrent load: re-run with LATTICE_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS bumped and clear the orphan .lattice/locks/validation/<id>.lock (records the dead validate pid) between attempts.
